text: I want to use numbers to check everyday problems.
A bus leaves at 09:45 and arrives at 10:20 on the same morning. How long was the trip? Explain.

lesson.declared_goal: Use quantitative reasoning in everyday situations
lesson.exercise: A bus leaves at 09:45 and arrives at 10:20 on the same morning. How long was the trip? Explain.
outline: Apply it to a different setting

rubric.criterion: Account for the hour boundary and report thirty-five minutes.
